summary: Verified fix for duplicate/wrong drink images on One Dot menu. Backend GET /api/menu returns 26 items, all with reachable images. All Hot (11) and Cold (7) images are distinct. Expected slug assignments (Americano, Macchiato, Cortado, Flat White, Latte, Spanish Latte, Caramel Latte, White Mocha, Hot Chocolate, Ice White Mocha, Ice Caramel Latte) all match. Frontend renders all product-card images with naturalWidth>0. Product modal opens and shows the drink image loaded (1200x1804 for Ice Spanish Latte).

issues: A11y console error: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle and aria-describedby. Wrap with VisuallyHidden or provide DialogTitle for screen readers.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) and Description/aria-describedby to ProductModal to satisfy Radix Dialog a11y requirements.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_data.py IMG dict + MENU_ITEMS assignments now consistent with expected photo slugs and produce unique images across Hot/Cold.
ProductModal missing accessible title/description (Radix warning) – add a11y-only DialogTitle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu image duplication/correctness bug is fully resolved. Only remaining minor item is a Radix Dialog a11y warning in ProductModal (missing DialogTitle/Description). Verified via /api/menu that assignments are unique within Hot/Cold and match the expected slugs.
